source: game/config/room_catalog.gd (+ PropModelCatalog.HUNTER_SCALE from game/config/prop_model_catalog.gd for surface_height)
notes: All data is const in GDScript; RoomCatalog never consults ContentRegistry, so there is no mod-pack resolution. Vector2 footprint components are float32 in Godot (single-precision build): parse x/y as f32 and widen to f64 when doing arithmetic. See NOTES.md.
footprint_rule: footprint(type, rotation): v = FOOTPRINTS.get(type, Vector2(.32, .32)); return Vector2(v.y, v.x) if abs(rotation) % 2 == 1 else v. I.e. rotations 1 and 3 (and -1, -3) swap x/y; 0 and 2 return (x, y) unchanged. Values are f32 (Godot Vector2). Unknown types (not in FOOTPRINTS) use (0.32, 0.32).
solid_rule: is_solid(type) = type NOT IN non_solid_types. Any type not listed (including unknown ones) is solid.
surface_height_rule: surface_height(parent) = float(SURFACE_HEIGHTS.get(parent, 0.8)) * PropModelCatalog.hunter_scale(parent) where hunter_scale = float(HUNTER_SCALE.get(parent, 1.0)); f64 arithmetic.
